# IntentHandler
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/intent-system/src/contracts/IntentHandler.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IIntentHandler](../interfaces/i-intent-handler.md), ReentrancyGuard, ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
IntentHandler

Contract that manages the lifecycle of intent-based bonds using individual solver bond contracts

Handles intent creation, solving, activation, settlement, and resignation

Deploys escrows for each solver to hold yield

